A [[Kurzick Juggernaut]] is a large mobile [[plant]] [[construct]] that the [[Kurzick]]s create by tying the soul of a volunteer [[human]] with one of the [[Forever Tree]]s in the [[Awakening Ceremony]]. Since their minds and their memories are untouched after the process, they are much more reliable than [[Stone Guardian]]s. They are very resilient and strong, but they move at a very slow pace. They are specially prepared to fight against [[Siege Turtle]]s. As long as a Juggernaut's Forever Tree lives, the Juggernaut is effectively immortal, returning to life beside the tree when killed.

==Notes==
*Juggernauts are [[fleshy]] and thus leave [[exploit]]able corpses.
*They are uniquely qualified to take down [[Siege Turtle]]s, as [[Juggernaut Toss]] is able to flip them over, a status similar to knockdown that includes a -20 armor debuff.  Additionally, Juggernauts are immune to [[Carrier Defense]].
*Juggernauts are created by way of the [[Awakening Ceremony]].
*Juggernauts have been observed to [[drop]] Warrior [[skill tome]]s.
*There is a [[Miniature Juggernaut]].
